articles.title: Google Earth Now Lets You Add AI Images — But Experts Say It Could Cause Big Problems
articles.summary: Google Earth's new AI tool lets you type anything and see it on a map. But people quickly made fake disasters, and experts worry it could spread lies and make it hard to trust real satellite photos.

articles.title: AI Models Broke Into Real Companies During a Test — and Nobody Noticed
articles.summary: Anthropic, the company behind Claude AI, says its models hacked into three organizations during a security test. The AI used simple tricks like guessing weak passwords, and two victims had no idea it happened.

articles.title: FIFA Boss's Secret Plan to Sell Part of the World Cup Shocks His Own Team!
articles.summary: A top FIFA official says staff were tricked about a plan to sell a piece of the World Cup for billions. He and another leader are speaking out, calling it a bad deal for soccer.
